name: betterdb
description: Valkey and Redis observability from BetterDB Monitor: health, slowlog, latency, memory, hot keys, anomalies and cluster state

betterdb_url.title: BetterDB URL
betterdb_url.description: URL of your BetterDB Monitor, for example https://<workspace>.app.betterdb.com or http://localhost:3001

betterdb_token.title: MCP token
betterdb_token.description: Token from Settings → MCP Tokens in BetterDB. Leave empty for a local monitor without auth

betterdb_instance_id.title: Instance ID
betterdb_instance_id.description: Instance to use at the start of each session, for monitors with several instances. Leave empty to pick one with select_instance

telemetry.title: Usage telemetry
telemetry.description: Send tool usage events (tool name, success, duration, error) to your BetterDB Monitor
